key.name: company-domain
key.description: The subdomain before .bamboohr.com in your company's BambooHR URL. For https://mycompany.bamboohr.com this is "mycompany".

key.name: api-key
key.description: Personal API key generated in BambooHR (avatar menu → API Keys). Sent as HTTP Basic auth username; keep this secret.

key.name: employee-id
key.description: Your BambooHR employee ID. 0 means "detect automatically" via GET /api/v1/employees/0, which resolves to the API key's owner.

key.name: refresh-interval-in
key.description: How often the status is refreshed while you are clocked in.

key.name: refresh-interval-out
key.description: How often the status is refreshed while you are clocked out.
